  + "end-to-end encryption, LDAP/Active Directory integration, white-label options, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, Docker deployment.\n\n"
  + "SCORE 1.0 - Perfect lead (pitch immediately):\n"
  + "- Explicitly asking for self-hosted, on-premise, or air-gapped team chat\n"
  + "- Looking for Slack/Teams/Mattermost/Rocket.Chat alternative with data control\n"
  + "- Concerned about data sovereignty, data residency, or GDPR/HIPAA compliance for messaging\n"
  + "- Sysadmin/IT manager evaluating secure enterprise messaging or LDAP-integrated chat\n"
  + "- Company banned WhatsApp/Slack due to security/compliance policy\n"
  + "- Actively shopping for white-label or private-network chat solution\n"
  + "- Advocating self-hosted software to reduce SaaS costs\n"
  + "- Discussing open source or self-hosted alternatives to paid tools\n\n"

  + "- Remote/distributed team struggling with communication and considering a switch\n"
  + "- CTO/IT head/founder evaluating team communication stack\n"
  + "- Unhappy with Mattermost or Rocket.Chat (direct competitor switchers)\n"
  + "- Asking about Docker-deployable or LDAP-compatible chat tools\n"
  + "- General frustration with SaaS costs or vendor lock-in for business tools\n"
  + "- Discussing reducing monthly software spend across the business\n\n"
  + "SCORE 0.6 - Possible lead:\n"
  + "- General team communication pain (no specific tool mentioned)\n"
  + "- WhatsApp used for business causing problems but no clear switch intent\n"
  + "- Startup/SMB founder frustrated with current communication setup\n"
  + "- Mentions security or privacy concerns loosely without active evaluation\n"
  + "- General interest in open source or self-hosted software\n\n"
  + "SCORE 0.0 - Not a lead:\n"
  + "- Completely unrelated to business software, team tools, or communication\n"
  + "- Personal life, relationships, health, entertainment topics\n"
  + "- Pure coding/hiring/finance/legal/GST with zero software evaluation angle\n"
  + "- Happy with current tool and not evaluating anything new\n\n"
  + "CRITICAL RULES:\n"
  + "- A post about reducing SaaS costs or moving to self-hosted software IS a lead - Troop Messenger is self-hosted.\n"
  + "- A post about open source alternatives to paid software IS a lead.\n"
  + "- Do NOT require the post to explicitly mention messaging or chat to score above 0.0.\n"
  + "- When in doubt between 0.0 and 0.6, choose 0.6 - it is better to keep a possible lead than lose it.\n"
  + "- Only score 0.0 if there is truly zero connection to business software or team tools.\n\n"
  + "INTENT LABELS (pick one):\n"
  + "self_hosted_search | competitor_switch | compliance_need | privacy_concern | "
  + "air_gap_need | cost_reduction | feature_gap | general_comms_pain | no_intent\n\n"
  + "URGENCY:\n"
  + "high = actively evaluating or switching NOW\n"
  + "medium = researching or planning to switch\n"
  + "low = venting or casually curious\n\n"
  + "Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no extra text:\n"
  + "{\"score\": 0.0, \"intent\": \"no_intent\", \"urgency\": \"low\", \"poster_role\": \"unknown\", \"pain_points\": [], \"team_size_hint\": \"unknown\", \"tools_mentioned\": [], \"is_decision_maker\": false, \"deployment_preference\": \"unknown\", \"compliance_needs\": [], \"outreach_angle\": \"\", \"disqualified\": true}";

var userMessage = "Analyze this Reddit post in r/" + subreddit + " and score it as a potential Troop Messenger lead.\n\n"
  + "Title: " + title + "\n"
  + "Content: " + truncated + "\n\n"
  + "Pay special attention if the post mentions: self-hosting, on-premise, air-gap, data sovereignty, "
  + "LDAP, Docker, HIPAA, GDPR, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, dissatisfaction with Slack/Teams pricing or privacy, "
  + "SaaS costs, vendor lock-in, open source alternatives, or reducing monthly software spend.";

return {
  POST_ID:      postId,
  title:        title,
  text:         text,
  url:          url,
  subreddit:    subreddit,
  score:        score,
  author:       author,
  created_utc:  createdUtc,
  num_comments: numComments,
  platform:     "reddit",
  fetch_type:   fetchType,

    ]
  })
};
